{{Quote|She's a Child of the Emperor, like me. And it's time she returned to our father's warm embrace.|Valis|<ref name="Defector" />}}
'''Valis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] will. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and raised at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Valis was a loyal servant of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. During the tense [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was ordered to retrieve the former Child [[Kira Carsen]] when the Emperor became aware of her continued existence. Posing as the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hacklin]], Valis lured Carsen, now a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and [[Hero of Tython|her Master]] to a [[Czerka asteroid mining facility|mining facility]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], but his attempt to capture Carsen resulted in a [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|duel]] that ended with his [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Greetings. I am Valis. Your quick response is most appreciated. Please forgive the deception&mdash;Admiral Hacklin remains Darth Angral's faithful servant. His name simply made this meeting convenient.|Valis|<ref name="Defector" />}}
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Valis was taken from his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] as an infant and sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where he was inducted into the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="Escaping Korriban" /> Alongside fellow recruits such as [[Kira Carsen]],<ref name="Defector" /> [[Suri]], and [[Tannac]], Valis underwent training in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and he was taken to see the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] on several occasions. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] he was a teenager, Valis had become a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], an extension of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] will, and was imbued with a portion of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler's power. However, in [[3653 BBY]], his fellow Child Carsen escaped from Korriban, as she feared what the Emperor was doing to her mind, and she later joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Escaping Korriban" />

[[File:Valis_talks.png|thumb|left|170px|Valis converses with the two Jedi.]]
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Emperor was alerted to Carsen's continued existence when the former Child was captured by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] aboard the [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station]]. Carsen escaped her captors with the help of her [[Hero of Tython|Master]], the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], but the Emperor ordered Valis to bring Carsen back to him. Posing as the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hacklin]], Valis contacted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and claimed that he wanted to defect&mdash;but that he would only do so if he could meet with Carsen, whom Hacklin had met when the girl had been captured by Angral. Valis then took a [[Valis's ship|starship]] to an [[Czerka asteroid mining facility|asteroid mining facility]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the meeting place that Suthra had selected for the defection. Valis disembarked his ship and hid behind several cargo crates in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], watching as Carsen and her [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] teacher arrived in [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|their ship]]. When the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] reached his ship, Valis stepped out from his hiding place and greeted the pair.<ref name="Defector" />

Introducing himself and apologizing for using Hacklin's name in his deception, the Sith was recognized by Carsen, and he was amused at how his sibling immediately warned her Master to attack. Valis then informed the Knight of Carsen's true past, warning the former Child that the Emperor wanted her back, and asked her Master to peacefully leave him to settle the matter with Carsen. However, the Knight refused, and Carsen rushed her "sibling" to attack him with her [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. Valis drew his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to his [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and ignited the [[Color/Legends|purple]] blade in time to block Carsen's strike before throwing her backward with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Carsen's Master then joined her in battling Valis, and the Sith unleashed arcs of violet [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at his opponents as the three [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|dueled]] back and forth across the hangar. Despite his strength in the Force, however, Valis was unable to overcome the combined strength of Carsen and the Knight, and their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] ended when Valis was [[Death/Legends|struck down]] by the Jedi.<ref name="Defector" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've never heard of any 'Emperor's Children.' Who are you people?''"<br />"''The chosen ones&mdash;selected at birth to serve our father's great glory. A distinction we should wear with pride.|The Knight and Valis|<ref name="Defector" />}}
Fair-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] and fair-skinned with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Valis was arrogant and confident in his superior strength and power. Despite this, Valis was cultured and polite, and he was perfectly willing to allow the Knight to leave if the Jedi allowed him to take Carsen peacefully&mdash;but he would not back down from his mission to retrieve the wayward Child at any costs. Valis took great pride in his status as a Child of the Emperor, and he truly considered the Emperor to be his father.<ref name="Defector" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Valis_blocks_Kira.png|thumb|right|170px|Valis defends himself from Kira.]]
{{Quote|Deception comes easily to our family. The dark side runs strong in us.|Valis|<ref name="Defector" />}}
Trained at the [[Sith academy|Sith Academy]], Valis was strong in the Force and skilled in the use of the dark side. He freely utilized offensive [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in combat, making use of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to throw his opponents across the battlefield as well as energy blasts and Force lightning during his battle with Carsen and the Knight. Valis carried a purple-bladed lightsaber that featured a talon-like ornament on the base of the hilt and three evenly-spaced metal blades attached to the emitter.<ref name="Defector" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valis first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. Voiced by [[Nicholas Boulton]], Valis is the antagonist in the Jedi Knight class mission "The Defector," which players undertake after completing the class storylines on the planets [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Regardless of the dialogue options taken by the player during the conversation with Valis, the player will be forced to duel the Child, and he will be killed in combat.<ref name="Defector" />
